title: Classic 90s Romances
description: Test your knowledge of the iconic romantic Bollywood films that defined the 1990s, from DDLJ to Kuch Kuch Hota Hai.

questions.text: In DDLJ, what does Raj's father gift him after he fails his exams in London?
options: A classic red Harley Davidson motorcycle
A month-long trip across Europe (EuroRail pass)
A luxury apartment in Mayfair, London
A film camera to pursue his passion

questions.text: In Saajan, what is unique about the character Aman, played by Sanjay Dutt?
options: He is a famous poet writing under a pseudonym
